added_lemmas.statement:
Let
\[
 \mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 =\left\{\lambda\ge0:
 \sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\sum_{r\in\mathcal R_x}\lambda_{xr}=1,
 \ \sum_{r\in\mathcal R_x}\lambda_{xr}\ge\pi_*\ \forall x,
 \ \sum_{x,r}\lambda_{xr}
 \mathbf 1\{D_r(1)>D_r(0),S_r(0)=S_r(1)=1\}\ge m_*
 \right\}.
\]
Then
\[
 \mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 =T_0\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 =\{q\in\Delta(\mathcal J):\Xi(q)\ne\varnothing\}
 =\{q\in\Delta(\mathcal J):\mathcal F(q)\ne\varnothing\}.
\]
It is a rational polytope. Exact rational elimination first decides whether it is empty.  When it is nonempty, the finite rational response-type data yield an irredundant relative representation
\[
 \mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\{q:Eq=e,\ F_iq\le f_i,\ i\in I\},
 \qquad
 \operatorname{aff}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})=\{q:Eq=e\},
\]
and therefore certify \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\) by exact rational linear programming and row-space arithmetic.
added_lemmas.proof_tex:
The technique is finite response-type projection followed by exact rational polyhedral elimination.  Remove the equation \(T_0\lambda=p\) from the definition of \(\Xi(p)\); the remaining constraints are exactly those defining \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  Consequently, for every \(q\in\Delta(\mathcal J)\),
\[
 \Xi(q)\ne\varnothing
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \exists\lambda\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\text{ with }T_0\lambda=q
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 q\in T_0\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}. \tag{1}
\]
The already established response-type fiber equivalence gives
\[
 \Xi(q)\ne\varnothing
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 \mathcal F(q)\ne\varnothing. \tag{2}
\]
Equations (1) and (2), together with the definition of \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), prove all three set equalities.

All coefficients in \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) and \(T_0\) are rational.  Nonnegativity and unit total mass imply \(0\le\lambda_{xr}\le1\), so \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) is bounded; it is closed because it is the intersection of finitely many closed rational half-spaces and hyperplanes.  Moreover, because \(\bar\pi_0(x)+\bar\pi_1(x)=1\),
\[
 \sum_{j\in\mathcal J}(T_0\lambda)_j
 =\sum_{x,r}\lambda_{xr}\sum_{z=0}^1\bar\pi_z(x)=1,
\]
and every coordinate of \(T_0\lambda\) is nonnegative.  Eliminate the finitely many coordinates of \(\lambda\) from
\[
 \lambda\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}},\qquad q=T_0\lambda
\]
by successive pairwise inequality elimination.  To verify exactness of one step, isolate a coordinate \(x\) and write its constraints as
\[
 \ell_s(y)\le x\quad(s\in S),\qquad
 x\le u_t(y)\quad(t\in T),\qquad
 g_k(y)\le0\quad(k\in K),
\]
where all displayed functions are rational affine functions.  Such an \(x\) exists exactly when
\[
 \ell_s(y)\le u_t(y)\quad\forall(s,t)\in S\times T,
 \qquad g_k(y)\le0\quad\forall k\in K;
\]
if \(S\) or \(T\) is empty, choose \(x\) beyond the finitely many one-sided bounds.  Thus one step is equivalent to finitely many rational inequalities.  Iteration gives a finite rational system for \(T_0\mathcal L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  The image is bounded because \(q\in\Delta(\mathcal J)\).  Hence \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) is a rational polytope.

The same elimination decides emptiness.  Conditional on nonemptiness, redundancy of any output inequality is decided by maximizing its rational left-hand side subject to the other rational constraints.  Gaussian elimination applied to the equalities that hold throughout the resulting polytope gives rational matrices \(E,e\) with affine hull \(Eq=e\); the remaining nonredundant inequalities are the relative facets \(F_iq\le f_i\).  Hence
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 Ep_0=e\ \text{ and }\ F_ip_0<f_i\ \forall i\in I. \tag{3}
\]
Moreover
\[
 \operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)=\ker E,
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad EB=0. \tag{4}
\]
Every comparison in (3) and every equality in (4) is exact rational arithmetic.  This proves the certification claim.

added_lemmas.statement:
Suppose \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  For every \(u\in\mathbb R^d\) there is \(t_u>0\) such that
\[
 p_0+tBu\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 \qquad\text{for every }0\le t\le t_u.
\]
For rational \(u\), a positive rational \(t_u\) is computable from the rational relative-facet representation, and for every rational \(t\in[0,t_u]\) a rational response-type lift \(\lambda(t,u)\in\Xi(p_0+tBu)\) is computable.  Thus every tangent direction has a compatible full-law lift; feasibility is derived and is not assumed on an ambient simplex neighborhood.
added_lemmas.proof_tex:
Use the rational relative representation from the compatible-observed-law-polytope lemma,
\[
 \mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\{q:Eq=e,\ F_iq\le f_i,\ i\in I\}.
\]
Put \(L=\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)=\ker E\) and \(v=Bu\).  The image condition gives \(v\in L\), hence
\[
 E(p_0+tv)=Ep_0+tEv=e \qquad(t\in\mathbb R). \tag{5}
\]
Relative interior gives a strictly positive slack
\[
 \gamma_i=f_i-F_ip_0>0\qquad(i\in I). \tag{6}
\]
With the minimum over an empty set interpreted as \(+\infty\), define
\[
 t_u=\min\left\{1,\ \min_{i:F_iv>0}\frac{\gamma_i}{2F_iv}\right\}>0. \tag{7}
\]
If \(0\le t\le t_u\) and \(F_iv>0\), then (6)--(7) give
\[
 F_i(p_0+tv)
 =f_i-\gamma_i+tF_iv
 \le f_i-\frac{\gamma_i}{2}<f_i. \tag{8}
\]
If \(F_iv\le0\), then
\[
 F_i(p_0+tv)\le F_ip_0=f_i-\gamma_i<f_i. \tag{9}
\]
Equations (5), (8), and (9) prove \(p_0+tBu\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  By the defining equality \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\{q:\mathcal F(q)\ne\varnothing\}\) and the established fiber-polytope equivalence, there exists \(\lambda(t,u)\in\Xi(p_0+tBu)\), and its response-type construction induces a law in \(\mathcal F(p_0+tBu)\).  When \(u\) and \(t\) are rational, all constraints have rational coefficients, and exact rational linear programming returns a basic feasible \(\lambda(t,u)\).  Formula (7) supplies the computable rational upper step.  This is the promised computable lift.

added_lemmas.statement:
Suppose \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\), \(p_n(0)\to p_0\),
\[
 \sup_{u\in C}\left\|\sqrt n\{p_n(u)-p_n(0)\}-Bu\right\|_2\to0
 \quad\text{for every compact }C\subset\mathbb R^d,
\]
and \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\) for every \((n,u)\).  Then every compact \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\) is contained in \(\mathcal U_n\) for all sufficiently large \(n\).
added_lemmas.proof_tex:
Let \(L=\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  By relative interior, there is \(r_{\mathrm{rel}}>0\) such that
\[
 \{p_0+z:z\in L,\ \|z\|_2\le r_{\mathrm{rel}}\}
 \subseteq\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}. \tag{10}
\]
Fix a compact \(C\).  The local expansion and boundedness of \(B C\) give
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \sup_{u\in C}\|p_n(u)-p_0\|_2
 &\le \|p_n(0)-p_0\|_2
   +n^{-1/2}\sup_{u\in C}\|Bu\|_2\\
 &\quad+n^{-1/2}\sup_{u\in C}
 \left\|\sqrt n\{p_n(u)-p_n(0)\}-Bu\right\|_2
 \longrightarrow0.
 \end{aligned} \tag{11}
\]
The affine-hull condition places every difference in (11) in \(L\).  For all sufficiently large \(n\), (11) is at most \(r_{\mathrm{rel}}\); (10) then implies \(p_n(u)\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) for every \(u\in C\).  The corrected definition of \(\mathcal U_n\) therefore gives \(C\subseteq\mathcal U_n\).

added_lemmas.statement:
Let \(0\le\rho<1\), and let \(\widetilde K\) be a randomized rule satisfying
\[
 \inf_{v\in V}\inf_{h\in D_v}P_h\{v\in\widetilde K(W)\}
 \ge1-\eta-\rho.
\]
Set \(q=\rho/(\eta+\rho)\), and let \(K^+=\operatorname{Repair}_{\eta,\rho}(\widetilde K)\).  Then \(K^+\in\mathcal C_\eta\), and
\[
 \sup_{h\in H_r}E_h\ell\{K^+(W)\}
 \le
 \sup_{h\in H_r}E_h\ell\{\widetilde K(W)\}
 +\frac{D\rho}{\eta+\rho}.
\]

Suppose \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Under the completed branch construction in \(\mathcal B_0\), every \(u\in\mathbb R^d\) belongs to some feasible optimal tangent cell \(P_{v,b}^0\).  Consequently,
\[
 \bigcup_{v\in V}D_v^0=\mathbb R^d.
\]
added_lemmas.proof_tex:
The technique is a finite active-set stability argument applied to the compatible convex-polyhedral lift.  Fix \(u\in\mathbb R^d\).  The relative-interior tangent-lift lemma supplies \(t_u>0\) such that
\[
 q_t=p_0+tBu\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}
 \qquad(0<t\le t_u). \tag{15}
\]
By the compatible-polytope representation and fiber equivalence, \(\Xi(q_t)\ne\varnothing\).  The feasible response weights satisfy \(0\le\lambda_{xr}\le1\) and finitely many closed linear constraints; hence \(\Xi(q_t)\) is compact.  Each separate endpoint program therefore has a primal optimizer.  To expose the dual step, write any fixed branch program as
\[
 \max_x c'x\quad\text{subject to}\quad Gx\le g,\ Hx=h. \tag{16}
\]
At a maximizer \(x_*\), let \(I\) index its active inequalities.  There is no direction \(d\) satisfying \(G_Id\le0\), \(Hd=0\), and \(c'd>0\), because a sufficiently small positive step from \(x_*\) would otherwise remain feasible and increase (16).  Applying the same finite pairwise linear-inequality elimination used above to this infeasible direction system yields multipliers \(y_I\ge0\) and \(z\) such that
\[
 c=G_I'y_I+H'z. \tag{17}
\]
Extend \(y_I\) by zeros off \(I\).  Then every feasible \(x\) obeys
\[
 c'x=y'Gx+z'Hx\le y'g+z'h,
\]
while equality holds at \(x_*\) because \(y_i(G_ix_*-g_i)=0\).  Hence \((y,z)\) is a dual optimizer.  Every endpoint value is finite because the wage grid is finite.  Thus at least one primal--dual feasible optimal branch completion exists at \(q_t\).

There are finitely many cuts \(\psi(p)=\alpha_\psi'p+\beta_\psi\).  If \(\psi(p_0)\ne0\), continuity of the affine map gives \(t_\psi>0\) for which
\[
 \operatorname{sign}\{\psi(q_t)\}=\operatorname{sign}\{\psi(p_0)\}
 \qquad(0<t<t_\psi). \tag{18}
\]
If \(\psi(p_0)=0\), then exactly
\[
 \psi(q_t)=t\alpha_\psi'Bu. \tag{19}
\]
Choose \(t>0\) below \(t_u\) and all the finitely many positive bounds in (18).  Select one feasible optimal completion at \(q_t\).  Equations (18)--(19) show that it agrees with every frozen base sign and with the weak tangent sign selected by \(u\).  If \(\alpha_\psi'Bu=0\), the equality-face convention places the cut in every incident completion.  Therefore this completion is one of the retained elements \(b\in\mathcal B_0\).  Its semantic assertion pattern has some retained representative \(v\in V\), and the same weak signs state precisely that
\[
 u\in P_{v,b}^0\subseteq D_v^0. \tag{20}
\]
Because \(u\) was arbitrary, (20) proves the asserted global cover.  Notice that (15), rather than feasibility of every ambient neighboring simplex law, is the only lawfulness step.

added_lemmas.statement:
Let \(\Sigma_0=\Sigma_0'\succ0\), let \(P_{v,b}^0=\{g:A_{v,b}^0g\le b_{v,b}^0\}\), let \(u_*\in\mathbb R^d\), and suppose row \(i\) has gap
\[
 \gamma=(A_{v,b}^0u_*-b_{v,b}^0)_i>0.
\]
If \(s\ge\|(A_{v,b}^0)_{i\cdot}\|_{\Sigma_0}>0\), then
\[
 \inf_{g\in P_{v,b}^0}\|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}
 \ge \frac{\gamma}{s}>0.
\]

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
Suppose \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Then every \(u\in\mathbb R^d\) has a compatible lift \(p_0+tBu\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) for all sufficiently small positive \(t\), admits a feasible optimal symbolic completion in \(\mathcal B_0\), and belongs to at least one completed semantic cell.  Hence
\[
 \bigcup_{v\in V}D_v^0=\mathbb R^d.
\]
Equality signs belong to all incident completions.  More generally, use the causally compatible offset space
\[
 \mathcal K_0=\{A_\Psi z:z\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\}.
\]
If \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), the compact-uniform moving remainders vanish, and a compact \(C\) has distance at least \(\tau>0\) from every hyperplane \(c_j+a_j'u=0\), then the lawful multinomial label on \(C\) eventually equals the label generated by \(D_v^0(c)\).  At \(c=0\) this is the label fan of \(\mathfrak G_0\).  If there are no active cuts, there is one retained global semantic label and the honest diameter minimax value is zero.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: Compatibility at one observed law and ambient multinomial interiority do not make every score direction feasible for the causal endpoint programs. The corrected claim uses relative interior of the compatible observed-law polytope and an exact tangent-image condition, from which the separate lifting lemma derives local feasibility.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
Under \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), the globally completed active tangent arrangement has a full-dimensional strict chamber unless there are no active cuts, in which case its unique component is \(\mathbb R^d\).  The canonical search returns \(P_{v_*,b_*}^0\), a rational point \(u_*\), and exact rational linear-programming certificates such that \(\rho_0>0\).  With \(r_0=\min\{r_{\mathrm{req}},\rho_0\}\),
\[
 \{v:u_*\in D_v^0\}=\{v_*\},\qquad
 \inf_{v\ne v_*}\inf_{g\in D_v^0}
 \|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}\ge r_0.
\]
Thus \(H_{r_0}\ne\varnothing\) for \(\mathfrak G_0\) without a causal margin assumption.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The strict-chamber and positive-distance conclusions require the corrected causal tangent cover. The narrowed statement inherits exactly the relative-interior and tangent-image conditions used to prove that cover.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
For every \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) with observed law \(p=p(P)\), the displayed cell contrasts identify the selected-complier submeasures.  The capacity formulas give valid marginal outer bounds, while \(\underline\Delta(t;p)\) and \(\overline\Delta(t;p)\) are the separate same-law infimum and supremum over \(\mathcal F(p)\), attained by \(P_t^-(p)\) and \(P_t^+(p)\).  Moreover
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p)
 \subseteq
 \prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p),\overline\Delta(t;p)],
\]
with no rectangle-equality claim.  For the tangent conclusion, fix \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and suppose
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0).
\]
For rational \((p_0,B)\), the compatible-direction lift proves that freezing nonzero base signs and retaining the active cuts \(\alpha_\psi'Bu\) yields closed rational cells \(P_{v,b}^0\) covering \(\mathbb R^d\), covariance \(\Sigma_0=\{B'\operatorname{diag}(p_0)^{-1}B\}^{-1}\), a certified nonempty separated domain, and a sample-size-free \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\).  No vector \(p_0+Bu\) is treated as a probability law.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The frozen theorem formed the fan at a base \(p_0\) not identified with the observed law \(p(P_0)\), and compatibility at one boundary point did not justify all directions of \(B\). The correction sets \(p_0=p(P_0)\), imposes the exact relative-interior and image conditions, and preserves the same-law outer-set claim.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
Conditional on effective compatibility density, the effective moving-remainder assumption, and effective moving-offset encoding, suppose
\[
 p_n(0)\to p_0,\qquad
 p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0),\qquad
 c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0,
\]
and \(\sup_{u\in C,j}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) for every rational compact polytope \(C\).  Here \(\mathcal K_0=\{A_\Psi z:z\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\}\), so \(c_n\in\mathcal K_0\).  Compute rational \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\) with \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n\), apply \(\operatorname{CertGluePFL}\) at vanishing accuracy to the encoded experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\), and transport its rule through the positive-cell multinomial comparison kernel.  On each fixed compact \(C\), the semantic-label coverage deficit and separated-risk excess are bounded by the comparison error, \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau_n+\xi_n)\), the moving-remainder charge, covariance and Gaussian-tail enclosures, semantic-union diameter inflation, and \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\).  The two effective moduli and certificate ledger compute \(\tau_n,\xi_n\downarrow0\) for which this compact-set bound vanishes.  The rule uses computable approximations to \(c_n\), not the unknown limit \(c\).  This does not assert global honesty on every unbounded region \(D_{n,v}\).
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The old offset space used only the ambient simplex tangent space, so \(\mathfrak G_0(c_n)\) could encode infeasible causal endpoint programs. The correction uses the causal affine-hull image and makes compact, rather than global, transfer explicit.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
Assume \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\), \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), and \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Also assume multinomial interiority, \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), the compact-uniform centered local expansion, effective moving-offset encoding, and \(c_n\to0\).  Then every fixed compact is contained in \(\mathcal U_n\) eventually, and
\[
 \max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0,
 \qquad
 [B'\operatorname{diag}\{p_n(0)\}^{-1}B]^{-1}\to\Sigma_0.
\]
Conditional on effective compatibility density, every finite atomic Gaussian dual certificate has a lawful compact multinomial realization whose value differs by the explicit positive-cell comparison remainder, and therefore
\[
 \liminf_{n\to\infty}M_n\ge M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
The reverse inequality requires the construction, rather than the assumption, of one sequence \(K_n\in\mathcal C_{n,\eta_0}\) that is globally honest on all unbounded regions \(D_{n,v}\) and satisfies
\[
 \limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{u\in H_{n,r_0}}
 E_{p_n(u)}[\ell_0\{K_n(N_n)\}]
 \le M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
Once that construction is proved,
\[
 \lim_{n\to\infty}M_n=M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
proposed_statement_changes.reason: This resubmits the required two-sided zero-offset target with \(c_n\to0\), compact-uniform remainder and covariance limits, and lawful causal-domain conditions. It retains the globally honest expanding-domain primal as a construction to be proved and does not replace the theorem by its lower-bound half.

proposed_statement_changes.proposed:
Assume the declared known assignment probabilities, instrument and stratum positivity, conditional randomization, treatment, selection, and outcome consistency, no defiers, complier-conditional directional weak selection monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0\).  Let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and impose
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0).
\]
For sampled-data transfer also impose multinomial interiority, base convergence, the centered local expansion, the local-family affine-hull condition, effective moving-offset encoding, and the effective moving-remainder condition; impose \(c_n\to0\) for the zero-offset minimax limit and allow \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\) for compact moving-offset transfer.  Form \(\mathcal F(p_0)\), compute the separate same-law coordinate endpoints, construct the completed tangent cells, and certify \(u_*\), \(\rho_0\), and \(r_0\).  Conditional on effective compatible density, termination, and the two-sided global transfer, these constructions give one simultaneous \(1-\eta_0\) honest semantic-label rule for every assertion in \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\), an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate Gaussian minimax certificate, and a vanishing global sampled-data receipt.  On compact direction sets away from active faces, tangent labels equal the eventual lawful multinomial labels.  The same-law joint set obeys only
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)\subseteq
 \prod_{t\in\mathcal T}[\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)],
\]
and no rectangle equality is asserted.
proposed_statement_changes.reason: The concrete deliverable must use an identified base \(p_0=p(P_0)\), the corrected compatible tangent geometry, and a local family lying in the compatible affine hull. Its global certificate and sampled-data conclusions remain explicitly conditional on the unresolved density, termination, and two-sided transfer theorems.

proposed_definition_changes.proposed:
For each \(n\in\mathbb N\),
\[
 \mathcal U_n=\{u\in\mathbb R^d:p_n(u)\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\}.
\]
proposed_definition_changes.reason: The endpoint map and semantic labels are defined only when the maintained causal fiber is nonempty. Calling every ambient-simplex value lawful was a formula error; the corrected domain is the preimage of the compatible observed-law polytope under \(p_n\).

proposed_assumptions.reason: Relative interior is the exact local domain condition ensuring a ball inside the compatible observed-law polytope relative to its affine hull. For the rational response-type encoding it is certified by strict rational facet slack, not by assuming an ambient-simplex neighborhood.

This exact row-space condition restricts the score directions to the affine tangent space of observable causal laws. It is verified by \(EB=0\) for a rational equality description of the compatible polytope and does not assume label cover or endpoint-program feasibility.

proposed_assumptions.condition: \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\) for every \(n\in\mathbb N\) and every \(u\in\mathbb R^d\).
proposed_assumptions.reason: A compact-uniform approximation can have an arbitrarily small component transverse to a lower-dimensional compatible-law polytope. Requiring the selected local family to obey the polytope's exact affine equalities lets relative interior and the proved expansion derive eventual compact lawfulness; it does not require every nearby ambient-simplex law to be compatible.

proposed_assumptions.condition: For every \(n\in\mathbb N\) and every positive rational \(\xi\), an algorithm returns \(\widehat c_{n,\xi}\in\mathcal K_0\cap\mathbb Q^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\) satisfying \(\|\widehat c_{n,\xi}-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi\).
proposed_assumptions.reason: CertGluePFL accepts rationally encoded experiments. Effective approximation inside the rational compatible-offset subspace makes each call well typed without restricting the scientific sequence to rational offsets; the approximation error is charged by enlarging the Gaussian boundary band.

proposed.statement:
Suppose \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Then every \(u\in\mathbb R^d\) has a compatible lift \(p_0+tBu\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) for all sufficiently small positive \(t\), admits a feasible optimal symbolic completion in \(\mathcal B_0\), and belongs to at least one completed semantic cell.  Hence
\[
 \bigcup_{v\in V}D_v^0=\mathbb R^d.
\]
Equality signs belong to all incident completions.  More generally, use the causally compatible offset space
\[
 \mathcal K_0=\{A_\Psi z:z\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\}.
\]
If \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), the compact-uniform moving remainders vanish, and a compact \(C\) has distance at least \(\tau>0\) from every hyperplane \(c_j+a_j'u=0\), then the lawful multinomial label on \(C\) eventually equals the label generated by \(D_v^0(c)\).  At \(c=0\) this is the label fan of \(\mathfrak G_0\).  If there are no active cuts, there is one retained global semantic label and the honest diameter minimax value is zero.
proposed.justification: The proposition now derives the global tangent cover from a compatible-law polytope lift rather than from an ambient-simplex neighborhood.
proposed.gap: Weak-sign bookkeeping alone does not ensure a feasible endpoint-program completion; the relative-interior lift supplies that missing causal-domain step.

proposed.statement:
Under \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\) and \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), the globally completed active tangent arrangement has a full-dimensional strict chamber unless there are no active cuts, in which case its unique component is \(\mathbb R^d\).  The canonical search returns \(P_{v_*,b_*}^0\), a rational point \(u_*\), and exact rational linear-programming certificates such that \(\rho_0>0\).  With \(r_0=\min\{r_{\mathrm{req}},\rho_0\}\),
\[
 \{v:u_*\in D_v^0\}=\{v_*\},\qquad
 \inf_{v\ne v_*}\inf_{g\in D_v^0}
 \|u_*-g\|_{\Sigma_0^{-1}}\ge r_0.
\]
Thus \(H_{r_0}\ne\varnothing\) for \(\mathfrak G_0\) without a causal margin assumption.

proposed.gap: Once the corrected cover is available, finite hyperplane avoidance and the violated-row Mahalanobis inequality complete the radius certificate.

proposed.statement:
For every \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) with observed law \(p=p(P)\), the displayed cell contrasts identify the selected-complier submeasures.  The capacity formulas give valid marginal outer bounds, while \(\underline\Delta(t;p)\) and \(\overline\Delta(t;p)\) are the separate same-law infimum and supremum over \(\mathcal F(p)\), attained by \(P_t^-(p)\) and \(P_t^+(p)\).  Moreover
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p)
 \subseteq
 \prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p),\overline\Delta(t;p)],
\]
with no rectangle-equality claim.  For the tangent conclusion, fix \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and suppose
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0).
\]
For rational \((p_0,B)\), the compatible-direction lift proves that freezing nonzero base signs and retaining the active cuts \(\alpha_\psi'Bu\) yields closed rational cells \(P_{v,b}^0\) covering \(\mathbb R^d\), covariance \(\Sigma_0=\{B'\operatorname{diag}(p_0)^{-1}B\}^{-1}\), a certified nonempty separated domain, and a sample-size-free \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\).  No vector \(p_0+Bu\) is treated as a probability law.

proposed.statement:
Conditional on effective compatibility density, the effective moving-remainder assumption, and effective moving-offset encoding, suppose
\[
 p_n(0)\to p_0,\qquad
 p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0),\qquad
 c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0,
\]
and \(\sup_{u\in C,j}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) for every rational compact polytope \(C\).  Here \(\mathcal K_0=\{A_\Psi z:z\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\}\), so \(c_n\in\mathcal K_0\).  Compute rational \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\) with \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n\), apply \(\operatorname{CertGluePFL}\) at vanishing accuracy to the encoded experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\), and transport its rule through the positive-cell multinomial comparison kernel.  On each fixed compact \(C\), the semantic-label coverage deficit and separated-risk excess are bounded by the comparison error, \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau_n+\xi_n)\), the moving-remainder charge, covariance and Gaussian-tail enclosures, semantic-union diameter inflation, and \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\).  The two effective moduli and certificate ledger compute \(\tau_n,\xi_n\downarrow0\) for which this compact-set bound vanishes.  The rule uses computable approximations to \(c_n\), not the unknown limit \(c\).  This does not assert global honesty on every unbounded region \(D_{n,v}\).

proposed.gap: The quantitative comparison lemma and a globally honest unbounded-domain construction remain absent; the theorem therefore retains compact-only scope.

proposed.statement:
Assume \(p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}})\), \(\operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), and \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).  Also assume multinomial interiority, \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), the compact-uniform centered local expansion, effective moving-offset encoding, and \(c_n\to0\).  Then every fixed compact is contained in \(\mathcal U_n\) eventually, and
\[
 \max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0,
 \qquad
 [B'\operatorname{diag}\{p_n(0)\}^{-1}B]^{-1}\to\Sigma_0.
\]
Conditional on effective compatibility density, every finite atomic Gaussian dual certificate has a lawful compact multinomial realization whose value differs by the explicit positive-cell comparison remainder, and therefore
\[
 \liminf_{n\to\infty}M_n\ge M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
The reverse inequality requires the construction, rather than the assumption, of one sequence \(K_n\in\mathcal C_{n,\eta_0}\) that is globally honest on all unbounded regions \(D_{n,v}\) and satisfies
\[
 \limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{u\in H_{n,r_0}}
 E_{p_n(u)}[\ell_0\{K_n(N_n)\}]
 \le M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
Once that construction is proved,
\[
 \lim_{n\to\infty}M_n=M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
proposed.justification: The corrected theorem retains both minimax inequalities and makes every local-limit premise and the required single global primal construction explicit.
proposed.gap: Finite atomic duality supports the certificate-first lower route, but compact comparison still does not control escaping separated means or construct the globally honest primal needed for the reverse inequality.
proposed.consumer: Only the completed two-sided theorem permits the Job Corps Gaussian certificate to be interpreted as the local multinomial minimax benchmark.

proposed.statement:
Assume the declared known assignment probabilities, instrument and stratum positivity, conditional randomization, treatment, selection, and outcome consistency, no defiers, complier-conditional directional weak selection monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0\).  Let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and impose
\[
 p_0\in\operatorname{relint}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}),
 \qquad
 \operatorname{im}(B)\subseteq\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0).
\]
For sampled-data transfer also impose multinomial interiority, base convergence, the centered local expansion, the local-family affine-hull condition, effective moving-offset encoding, and the effective moving-remainder condition; impose \(c_n\to0\) for the zero-offset minimax limit and allow \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\) for compact moving-offset transfer.  Form \(\mathcal F(p_0)\), compute the separate same-law coordinate endpoints, construct the completed tangent cells, and certify \(u_*\), \(\rho_0\), and \(r_0\).  Conditional on effective compatible density, termination, and the two-sided global transfer, these constructions give one simultaneous \(1-\eta_0\) honest semantic-label rule for every assertion in \(\mathscr A_{\mathrm{JC}}\), an \(\varepsilon\)-accurate Gaussian minimax certificate, and a vanishing global sampled-data receipt.  On compact direction sets away from active faces, tangent labels equal the eventual lawful multinomial labels.  The same-law joint set obeys only
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)\subseteq
 \prod_{t\in\mathcal T}[\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)],
\]
and no rectangle equality is asserted.

open_obligations.partial_result:
The established smoothing, one-chart averaging, and weighted-gluing inequalities give, respectively,
\[
 R_f\min\{1,s^2\sqrt{d/8}\},\qquad
 \frac{R_fk}{T\sqrt{2\pi}},\qquad
 \sum_e\Gamma_{C,e}^f+\frac{R_f}{2}\omega(h).
\]
Thus every fixed chart and every fixed compatible finite library has an explicit ledger.  These estimates do not construct one family on the entire recession-incidence poset whose edge discrepancies vanish simultaneously, and hence do not produce \(\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\downarrow0\).

open_obligations.partial_result:
If \(|e_{n,j}(u)|<\tau\) and \(|c_{n,j}+a_j'u|>\tau\), then \(\zeta_{n,j}(u)\) and \(c_{n,j}+a_j'u\) have the same sign.  Since \(a_j'W_0\) is normal with variance \(a_j'\Sigma_0a_j>0\),
\[
 \Pr\{|c_{n,j}+a_j'W_0|\le\tau\}
 \le \min\left\{1,\frac{2\tau}{\sqrt{2\pi}\{a_j'\Sigma_0a_j\}^{1/2}}\right\}.
\]
Summing over active facets gives \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\).  The corrected causal offset space and effective rational approximations make \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\) a valid encoded input, with offset error absorbed by replacing \(\tau\) with \(\tau+\xi_n\).  Compact localization still does not construct a globally honest rule on all unbounded \(D_{n,v}\).

If the selected local family obeys the affine equalities of \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), then relative interior, base convergence, and the compact-uniform centered expansion prove that every fixed compact lies in \(\mathcal U_n\) eventually. Zero-offset minimax convergence still requires \(c_n\to0\); a causal moving offset lies in \(\mathcal K_0=A_\Psi\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\).

The milliscale four-label certificate also remains open.

The relative-interior and tangent-image conditions are model-domain restrictions, not conclusions from multinomial cell positivity. The tangent lift is proved conditionally on those transparent restrictions. Effective density and termination remain unproved, moving-offset transfer remains compact-only, and the compact-exhaustion statement retains both minimax inequalities with the globally honest expanding-domain primal recorded as the missing construction.
